---
title: "buildwright dependency-health report"
format:
  html:
    toc: true
    embed-resources: true
    theme: cosmo
    code-fold: true
params:
  data_rds: null
engine: knitr
---

```{r setup, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(buildwright)

# Load the diagnosis written by report(); fall back to a bundled fixture so the
# template renders offline under R CMD check with no network and only bundled
# data.
diag <- if (!is.null(params$data_rds) && file.exists(params$data_rds)) {
  readRDS(params$data_rds)
} else {
  diagnose(bw_example("conflicted.lock"))
}

# Helper: collapse a list column into a comma-joined character vector so that
# knitr::kable can render it (list columns cannot be printed directly).
bw_join_list <- function(col, collapse = ", ") {
  vapply(col, function(x) paste(x, collapse = collapse), character(1))
}

# Null-coalescing helper, defined locally so the template does not depend on
# base R 4.4's `%||%` (the package supports R >= 4.2).
`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a)) b else a
```

# Executive summary

```{r exec-summary}
knitr::kable(summary(diag))
```

```{r exec-summary-text, results='asis'}
m <- diag$meta
cat(sprintf(
  paste0(
    "Diagnosed input `%s` (%s) containing **%d packages** for platform ",
    "**%s** on R %s (Bioconductor %s).\n"
  ),
  m$input %||% "?", m$type %||% "?", m$n_packages %||% nrow(diag$library),
  m$platform %||% "?", m$r_version %||% "?", m$bioc_version %||% "NA"
))
```

# Library inventory

```{r inventory-source}
src <- as.data.frame(table(diag$library$source))
names(src) <- c("source", "n")
knitr::kable(src, caption = "Packages by source")
```

```{r inventory-table}
inv <- diag$library[, c("package", "version", "source", "repository")]
knitr::kable(inv, caption = "Package inventory")
```

# Dependency structure

```{r dep-cycles, results='asis'}
cycles <- bw_cycles(diag$graph)
if (length(cycles) == 0L) {
  cat("No dependency cycles detected; a valid install order exists.\n")
} else {
  cat(sprintf("**%d dependency cycle(s) detected:**\n\n", length(cycles)))
  for (cyc in cycles) {
    cat(sprintf("- %s\n", paste(cyc, collapse = " -> ")))
  }
}
```

```{r dep-diamonds}
dia <- bw_diamonds(diag$graph)
if (nrow(dia) == 0L) {
  knitr::kable(
    data.frame(message = "No shared (diamond) dependencies."),
    col.names = ""
  )
} else {
  dia_top <- utils::head(dia, 10L)
  dia_top$dependents <- bw_join_list(dia_top$dependents)
  knitr::kable(dia_top, caption = "Top shared (diamond) dependencies")
}
```

```{r dep-plot, fig.width=8, fig.height=6, fig.cap="Dependency graph, coloured by source."}
# igraph plotting is wrapped in tryCatch so a plotting hiccup never fails the
# render. buildwright imports igraph, so no extra package is required.
tryCatch(
  {
    g <- diag$graph
    src_levels <- sort(unique(igraph::V(g)$source))
    palette <- grDevices::hcl.colors(max(length(src_levels), 1L), "Dark 3")
    vcol <- palette[match(igraph::V(g)$source, src_levels)]
    op <- graphics::par(mar = c(0, 0, 0, 0))
    on.exit(graphics::par(op), add = TRUE)
    plot(
      g,
      vertex.color = vcol,
      vertex.size = 12,
      vertex.label.cex = 0.7,
      vertex.label.color = "black",
      edge.arrow.size = 0.4,
      layout = igraph::layout_with_fr
    )
    graphics::legend(
      "bottomleft",
      legend = src_levels,
      col = palette[seq_along(src_levels)],
      pch = 19,
      bty = "n",
      cex = 0.8
    )
  },
  error = function(e) {
    plot.new()
    graphics::text(0.5, 0.5, sprintf("Graph plot unavailable: %s", conditionMessage(e)))
  }
)
```

# Conflicts

```{r conflicts, results='asis'}
conf <- diag$conflicts
if (nrow(conf) == 0L) {
  cat("**No dependency conflicts detected.** The library is internally consistent.\n")
}
```

```{r conflicts-table}
conf <- diag$conflicts
if (nrow(conf) > 0L) {
  conf_tbl <- conf[, c(
    "package", "type", "constraints", "installed_version", "satisfiable", "detail"
  )]
  knitr::kable(conf_tbl, caption = "Detected conflicts")
}
```

# System requirements

```{r sysreqs-summary, results='asis'}
sr <- diag$sysreqs
n_ok <- sum(sr$status == "ok", na.rm = TRUE)
n_missing <- sum(sr$status == "missing", na.rm = TRUE)
n_unknown <- sum(sr$status == "unknown", na.rm = TRUE)
cat(sprintf(
  "System requirements on platform **%s**: %d ok, %d missing, %d unknown.\n",
  attr(sr, "bw_platform") %||% diag$meta$platform %||% "?",
  n_ok, n_missing, n_unknown
))
```

```{r sysreqs-table}
sr <- diag$sysreqs
if (nrow(sr) == 0L) {
  knitr::kable(
    data.frame(message = "No system requirements mapped for this library."),
    col.names = ""
  )
} else {
  knitr::kable(sr, caption = "System requirements")
}
```

# Install simulation

```{r install-summary, results='asis'}
plan <- diag$plan
cat(sprintf(
  paste0(
    "Install simulation is **%s**: %d ok, %d warning(s), %d predicted ",
    "failure(s)/block(s).%s\n"
  ),
  if (isTRUE(plan$feasible)) "feasible" else "NOT feasible",
  plan$n_ok, plan$n_warn, plan$n_fail,
  if (isTRUE(plan$has_cycle)) " A dependency cycle is present." else ""
))
```

```{r install-failures}
plan <- diag$plan
pf <- plan$predicted_failures
if (nrow(pf) == 0L) {
  knitr::kable(
    data.frame(message = "No predicted failures."),
    col.names = ""
  )
} else {
  knitr::kable(pf, caption = "Predicted failures and blocks")
}
```

```{r install-order, results='asis'}
ord <- diag$plan$order
cat("**Dependency-first install order (first 20):**\n\n")
cat(paste(utils::head(ord, 20L), collapse = " -> "))
if (length(ord) > 20L) {
  cat(sprintf("\n\n... and %d more.\n", length(ord) - 20L))
}
```
